Org Skill · Create ACORD

Builds a CPKG ACORD application in Applied Epic from an SOV. Because it works in the browser, the setup is just like a carrier submission.

  1. Before running, confirm you're on your new Chrome profile (check via the profile icon top-right), on Sonnet.
  2. In Cowork, type /lo-create-acord and attach the SOV (Excel), then press the orange arrow or Enter.
  3. Claude opens Applied Epic in its own Chrome tab and asks you to log in. Log in manually — never save passwords or give Claude your credentials. Then tell it “I'm logged in, please continue.”
  4. When prompted for browser permission, choose “All for this website” so it can keep working without asking each time.
  5. Review before you finish. Once Claude has filled the application, check every field against the SOV yourself — Claude does the entry, you own the accuracy. Don't submit or print until it looks right.
